reason: role_gated. HertzFlow is a GMX-V2-style perp DEX on BSC whose only caller-paid functions are the keeper executions (executeOrder, executeHlvWithdrawal, executeDeposit/Withdrawal, liquidate, executeAdl), each gated by onlyOrderKeeper/onlyLiquidationKeeper/onlyAdlKeeper on RoleStore 0x616ee07aa245eb578c7443e598dcc8b4451bef30. The role lists are a closed whitelist of 8 admin-granted EOAs (no self-registration: grantRole is onlyRoleAdmin); eth_call of executeOrder (OrderHandler 0x7e953baa1bb0d8b8e14008490c3ffd22f3ea6f1a) and executeHlvWithdrawal (0xba3a1f7663500b4beeb8c98e910b116d10ae65fa) from a fresh address reverts Unauthorized 0xa35b150b. Even for a keeper the payment is only a gas reimbursement, so the whole protocol paid keepers ~$119 gross over 7 days.
